0x001BA1: A high-level Federation body handling secrets on Meteor 3 and the Aerogaters, formed of 13 core members of the Federation Security Council and ranking above the <EOTI Organization>. It was chaired by Karl Stresemann, the Security Council's vice-chairman. Aware of the Aerogaters' might from studies of Meteor 3 and <EOT>, it deemed Bian's all-out resistance stance dangerous and monitored and obstructed him - one factor behind the <DC> revolt. All members died in the L5 Campaign, ending the body.
0x001F14: fA long-established leader in shipbuilding, power plants and aircraft, with a strong aerospace record and a major defense role. While supplying Federation fighters like the F-32 Schwert, it dealt with the <EOTI Organization> and secretly mass-produced the Lion series during the <DC War>. The series ironically became the Federation mainstay after the <L5 Campaign>, so its DC ties went unpunished to secure production.
0x0021F6: The Inspectors were aliens from another star system who had been auditing Earth's civilization. Judging that humanity's insatiable fighting spirit would disturb galactic order, they schemed to control the Earth Sphere. The name 'Inspectors', coined offhandedly by their commander Vigagi while fighting the Hiryu Custom, became Earth's codename for them; their true name is unknown. Invading in New Era 187, their blitz seized the <White Star>, the Moon and key parts of North America. But caught between the Federation counteroffensive 'Operation Plantagenet' and the mass <Einst> outbreak, they were forced off Earth, then beaten at the White Star by the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom. With supreme commander Wendolo and other leaders dead, the Inspectors were destroyed - though some call them a mere advance force.
0x00276D: The upheaval caused by the Inspectors in New Era 187-188. They were aliens from another star system, auditing Earth's civilization, who judged that humanity's insatiable fighting spirit would disturb galactic order and schemed to control the Earth Sphere. Invading in 187, they blitzed the Moon and North America, but the mass Einst outbreak forced them off Earth, and the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom annihilated them.
0x002A98: %A device fitted to certain <T-LINK System>-equipped machines. Officially a T-LINK auxiliary, it activates forcibly under set conditions, taking over not just telekinetic devices but machine control, fire control and generator output. The machine briefly exceeds its catalog specs while badly straining the operator's brain and the machine. Sometimes called 'a system for inducing hysterical strength,' its details are known only to a few in the <SRX Project>. One theory says it came from Ingram Prisken, once the project's central figure and an Aerogater agent; its black-boxed core defies even Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi, the T-LINK System's developer.
0x002F6B: 'Aerogaters' is the Earth codename for the force that struck the Earth Sphere from Neviim, an automated planet that appeared suddenly at L5, using insectoid mobile weapons like the Megillot. They schemed to exploit humanity's superior combat ability for themselves, but lost in Operation SRW, the L5 Campaign's finale. They proved to be humans mentally conditioned by an unknown party - a fact kept strictly secret.
0x0032C5: AMN stands for Armored Module Network: a system that rapidly and accurately relays combat data from one <Armored Module> to others and shares it among multiple units. The former <EOTI Organization> and <DC> pursued its development, but slow mutual data exchange kept it from adoption.
